{{Top|leg}}

'''Mindscan droids''' were used by [[GeNode]] [[Clone Master/Legends|cloners]] to scan the mind of a [[Clone template/Legends|prime clone]] by perching on top of their cranium. The template's memories would then be [[Flash pumping|flash-pumped]] to the minds of their [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] late in the cloning process. The mad [[Geneticist/Legends|genetic]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] and clone master [[Zeta Magnus]] used these [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to create GeNode clones of [[Zeta Magnus (clone)|himself]], [[Anakin Skywalker (clone)|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi (clone)|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Halagad Ventor (clone)|Halagad Ventor]].
